t: $(thing)Semiblocks/$ are curious items which aren't quite blocks, but are placeable like blocks, and can exist in the same space as real blocks.$(p)See also $(l:logistics/frames)Logistics Frames/$ which are also technically semiblocks.
$(thing)半方块/$是一类很特别的物品。它们不完全算是方块，却能像方块一样放置，并且可以与真正的方块共存于同一空间中。$(p)另见$(l:logistics/frames)物流框架/$，它们从技术上来说也属于半方块。
